exact_missing_items: moving between live and historical mode should not require per-widget manual retargeting
a widget must not drift into a stale prior run just because its own config persisted an old scope choice
Node Graph tab must show a graph canvas with a right-side detail inspector
The inspector must expose: provider/model/effort/persona/account, usage/token/cost, worker policy, retry/review/promotion state, lane/worktree/snapshot, linked evidence
Every projection-backed operational surface should expose at least: trust state, last updated time, degraded/stale reason when not current, whether actions are partially gated
Progress: show run-level trust banner or chip when projections are stale/degraded
Seams: allow browsing, but gate actions that depend on current promotion/blocker truth
Node Graph: keep historical graph and current selections visible, but flag when live node state may be stale
Evidence: artifact browsing can remain available; live verdict/action affordances may gate
History / Ledger: usually the fallback-safe surfaces because they are closest to canonical records
